## Affected callers
- `cpp_visible_name_candidates` applies `cpp_unit_matches_kind` before matching names (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2892`); its free-function selection now excludes functions whose indexed parent is a class (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2925`). Both qualified and bare calls request this selection (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2731`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2799`).
- Bare identifier resolution passes the enclosing class to `cpp_member_candidates`, then retains fields (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2532`); that lookup now searches base classes when direct candidates are empty (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2983`).
- `resolve_cpp_field` supplies receiver types, member text, and optional call information to the changed member lookup (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2867`); an empty result produces `unsupported_cpp_receiver`, while a nonempty result goes to `candidates_outcome` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2868`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2986`).
- `cpp_field_expression_type` also calls the changed member lookup, with no arity or argument types, then selects a field's declared type (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3368`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3383`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2983`). This type feeds nested receiver resolution (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3441`).
- The added tests call the existing `lookup` helper (`tests/get_definition_test.rs:3919`, `tests/get_definition_test.rs:3955`), which constructs a service without the semantic index and invokes `get_definition_by_location` (`tests/get_definition_test.rs:7`).

## Paths
- In `resolve_cpp_call`, bare calls try visible free functions before looking up the enclosing class's members (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2792`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2813`); the class-parent predicate participates in the first stage (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2925`). Qualified calls similarly try free functions before resolving their scope as a type (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2724`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2747`).
- Both location queries and context-reference queries enter `resolve_definition_batch` (`src/searchtools.rs:802`, `src/searchtools.rs:897`); its C++ dispatch reaches member lookup through `resolve_cpp` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:303`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2532`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2986`).
- Direct candidates determine whether inherited lookup runs before call filtering (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2983`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2988`). The downstream arity filter returns its original candidates when its filtered collection is empty (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3089`); argument-type filtering likewise retains the arity-filtered collection (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3062`).
- Inherited candidates returned through member resolution reach `candidates_outcome` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2986`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2874`), which compares FQN/kind keys and returns definitions only for one semantic key (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:7730`). Location-result rendering serializes that status, definitions, and diagnostics (`src/searchtools.rs:1025`).

## Value flow
- The parent FQN read by `cpp_parent_is_class` comes from splitting a unit's FQN at its final dot (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:2937`); `DefinitionLookupIndex::insert` stores declarations under their complete FQNs, and `fqn` returns all units stored under the requested key (`src/analyzer/definition_lookup_index.rs:25`, `src/analyzer/definition_lookup_index.rs:46`).
- Direct member lookup forms `owner.fq_name() + "." + member` and fetches that index entry (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3008`); the index preserves multiple declarations per FQN (`src/analyzer/definition_lookup_index.rs:30`), and the lookup's sorting uses source path, FQN, and signature (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:7794`).
- The new inherited traversal obtains bases from `cpp_direct_base_types` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3023`), which reads the unit signature or source, splits at the first colon, and resolves comma-separated base names after removing access and `virtual` tokens (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3205`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3229`). The same helper supplies inheritance edges for argument-to-parameter assignability (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3197`).
- Base-name resolution in the inherited traversal uses `ctx.file` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3023`); `CppVisibilityIndex::resolve_type` searches that file's visible class and type-alias declarations (`src/analyzer/usages/cpp_graph/resolver.rs:167`), populated from the root file and its include closure (`src/analyzer/usages/cpp_graph/resolver.rs:110`).
- Each resolved base's FQN enters the traversal's shared `seen` set (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3024`). The FQNs originate in the indexed `CodeUnit`s returned by visibility type resolution (`src/analyzer/usages/cpp_graph/resolver.rs:174`); the traversal returns direct members from a base layer before descending to another layer (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:3032`).
